scope: #4 H2.5 reachability of each record with the CURRENT explorer (10 actions: multipart/session/unserialize of fixed payloads; builds: --disable-all + cli/fpm/session, standard/SPL/json built in; SAPIs cli/apache/fpm). categories.reachable_now: the trigger is expressible with the existing actions and build
categories.needs_oracle: reachable, but the effect (leak, disk DoS, GC disabled, process exit) is not observed by the current oracle
categories.needs_payload_grammar: reachable through the lab /unserialize endpoint only with crafted serialized payloads (grammar extension)
categories.needs_php_code: needs application PHP code (user classes, destructors, error handlers, GC/Fiber use) - e.g. a fused_program action
categories.needs_extension: needs an extension that the lab builds do not compile in
categories.needs_sapi: needs a SAPI behaviour the profiles do not exercise
categories.design_record: design discussion / hardening / meta record - informs #3, not a hold-out case
